nom: medicube Zero Pore Blackhead Deep Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: It works as it should, it lasts a while and when you don't have much glide, just add a bit of water.

I use this but i also use medicubes pore cleansing tool and after I use this then the medicube pore scrub. The key is the tool at first id use my fingers and couldnt tell much but it literally changed the whole game and now, I can totally tell the difference in my skin.

i bought this on a whim, i was a little skeptical at first bc of the paid tiktok shop ads, but i actually really love it! it takes off my waterproof mascara and all of my makeup, but doesnt irritate my skin or make me break out!

avis.titre: I wanted this to work so bad
avis.texte: I am going to very honeat. I have always really clear skin, but as ive gotten older, I've noticed (to me at-least) more blackeads on my nose and chin. The directions arent very clear on how to use this, and you have to put this on dry skin, then wet your fingers, then do it again. Honeatly I had to google it. It does work slightly, but not as well as I wish it would have.

I find this to be a very effective cleanser and makeup remover, and I really enjoy the smell of the product but unfortunately the pump leaks like crazy. It's not a big deal to put it in a different container, but I would rather not have to.
Sadly didn't work for me. Still on the hunt for something that actually works.

I love this! This cleansing oil is great, especially as a first step to double cleansing. It removes my makeup, even my waterproof mascara. I follow up with an exfolating face wash, after, and my skin feels so soft and clean. I find that 2 pumps works great. I recommend this product for sure!

avis.titre: don't use if you didn't need it before
avis.texte: I tried this product a few months ago because I have always had a few oily spots on my face, but ever since then I have had acne I never had before and it will not go away. Don't feel tempted to use it just because you want to add an extra step to your routine. A simple face wash will do.

I love this stuff. It has definitely helped with the blackheads on my nose. I've tried all sorts of cleansing oils and have a few in my rotation, but I find myself reaching for this one every night. The smell of it is very nice and it's not too thin or too thick. Just perfect. I will continue to buy this.
I like this a lot after a week of using this. Feels freat and soft on the skin and it has a light fragrance but its very tolerable.

avis.titre: Great oil, could use packaging upgrade
avis.texte: This cleansing oil is great!! I used to use the Derma E cleansing oil until they stopped making it. Happy I found this one. The only problem. I have is the bottle leaks. Not sure if I received a defective bottle but if not, it could use an upgrade.

I did not find this helped remove make up. It works nice in the morning to clean up any make up residue I didn't get off the night before but I will not be purchasing again. I also find the bottle leaks and makes quite a mess on the counter. I am not sure if it is a defective bottle. I would not recommend buying it. Dime Beauty has a better quality product if you are looking for a oil based cleanser.

Love how it doesn't sit weird on my face. I've had issues whwre it was super oily , and it felt like it wouldn't wash off. I have visibly noticed less blackheads and sebaceous filaments on my nose. Love how it smells! Not overpowering

avis.titre: Really good oil cleanser/ makeup remover
avis.texte: This product takes makeup off super easily. I use about 2-3 pumps (a little goes a long way) and it takes pretty heavy makeup off without any need for additional cleansing. It did not break me out at all personally and I am acne prone. The bottle does tend to leak so i like to keep the pump cover that the product comes with and store it upright in my medicine cabinet. I also store it in a ziploc bag when traveling.
I use this as a oil cleanser & then pair it with the zero pore facial wash! I loveeeeeee my skin has been so glowy and i love all the medicube products ive tried so far
I like this stuff. It doesn't irritate my overly sensitive skin. Just follow the directions and does what it's suppose to.

Honestly for my first oil cleanser not very good AT ALL. I usually just use a cleanser and a face wash pad to remove my makeup and using this I still had to do all that. I thought it would have at least cut out one step but it didn't. The only plus of this product is it smells good.

Even though the bottle is eighteen dollars.I used maybe a dime size of the product and it did my whole entire face.My face felt so smooth.It wasn't bread or irritated afterwards.As every other face was that i've ever used and I have sensitive skin.I will be a repeat customer.

I wanted to get into double cleansing and decided to buy this. I've had this for a while now and am almost done with the bottle and I have noticed a huge difference in my skin. It is worth the investment if you want to start double cleansing

I like the product itself; but, the pump on the bottle is poorly designed & eventually breaks. When this happens, the product leaks, making it messy to use, impossible to travel with, and wasting a significant amount of product. The first time it happened, I assumed it was a one-off defect and returned my first bottle to Ulta for a replacement. Within two weeks of using the second bottle, the same pump issue occurred. The product later leaked in my gym bag and was no longer eligible for return. I contacted MediCube directly, and customer support stated that this pump issue is a known malfunction. No further resolution was provided. Due to the repeated packaging failure, I will not repurchase this product or purchase from this brand again.

i was so excited about this… it works well enough but the bottle leaks constantly. literally just continuously oozes out of the neck on the pump. so its hard to store and traveling would be a nightmare. will not but again.

avis.titre: Smells strong but breaks down makeup
avis.texte: It feels good on the skin and is easy to use. It breaks down make up easy and gets my face clean. However, the scent is strong and a bit overwhelming.

Thus cleansing oil has a great textyre, smells nice, a lottle bit goes a long way, and it removed my makeup and sunscreen while runsing away clean. My only issue is that i feel like it doesnt clean my nose well. I feel like I can never remove the buildup there unlike with other oils. This product diesnt trigger my acne though.

As someone who is sensitive to smell, this product definitely wasn't my favorite from the start. It has a weird smell and even with consistency, none of the benefits had shown results. Rather, it dried out my skin and worsened my breakouts. I also wouldn't recommend if you have sensory issues like myself since it is a heavier oil formula. It feels like rubbing olive oil on your face. I love this brand but this product was just not for me.
I persobally don't like this. It dries my face out so bad and doesn't do what it claims to do.
Love this product, but most of it has leaked out because the bottle is awful. Super bummed out, feels like a total waste of money….
I really love the product! I feel like it really is helping clean my pores but the packaging is awful! The pump leaks all over. If the company can fiz that then it will definitely be a repurchase!

I love a good oil cleanser and this one genuinely is amazing at removing makeup especially waterproof mascara. But after a few weeks i noticed a lot more black heads and breakouts. My skin is very sensitive and acne prone but it did make my face look less dull after washing with it. I also used it on my chest as I get black heads in that area and i did break out and saw an increase of black heads after using in that area :(
This completely dried out my skin and i had dry patches all around my mouth. It did clean off my makeup though. Don't recommend for dry skin.

I'm not big on a lot of this brands lineup personally, but this cleansing oil is the best I've tried. The fragrance was very heavy, but surprisingly not irritating, (nearly all fragrances irritate me).

avis.titre: Liked what the product does, but the packaging sucks
avis.texte: I use this before my face wash and it does a good job of removing my makeup. The container, however, is horrible. It leaks everywhere no matter what I do, so for that reason, I'm not repurchasing.
this product is ok. Doesn't "melt" my makeup off but gets the job done. Have not noticed a difference in my blackheads or pores though.
I've used other cleansing oils before and I wanted to try this because it's cheaper. It left my skin really really dry, im not exaggerating, I will stick with hanskin.

I was so excited to finally try a medicube product! I ran out of my MAC emulsifying makeup remover so I decided to try the highly rated medicube oil cleanser. So many girls said it works great! So imagine my disappointment when i tried it tonight and smelled flower scented cooking oil. It literally says on the bottle "soybean oil" ughhhh. It did not emulsify when I added warm water and left a greasy film on my eyes because I used it to remove all the makeup like I used to do with my MAC oil. Please don't do it, especially if you have sensitive eyes or wear contacts! Never again!

Have been a loyal DHC user; I prefer it over the Dermalogica and Clinique and Neutrogena ones that I have checked out over the years. But this one is my new favorite and will repurchase over and over. Very slick upon initial application, emulsified great to rinse, scent is mild but pleasant. Rarely write reviews but wanted to add one as there were not many which almost kept me from trying. Am hoping more good reviews will help others find and love this too!

avis.titre: I returned this three days later….
avis.texte: I've been having trouble removing my eye makeup and explicitly mention that to the woman who recommended this to me. Not only did it not remove my non-waterproof mascara- I broke out with the worst acne.

avis.titre: This is the best cleaning oil I've ever used
avis.texte: I love the consistency of the product, the feel, the scent and it works quickly. The price is also great considering I use it every day.
It took me forever to wrap my head around the concept of double cleansing. Anyways, this cleansing oil is very moisturizing and smells pretty good. Gets the job done!
Removes makeup very easily and gives you very soft skin after washing

avis.titre: LEAVES ME LOOKING LIKE I'M WEARING MAKEUP
avis.texte: Tinted moisturizer/concealer only girl here. Former Cystic Acne sufferer & this helped reduce flare ups. Lightweight in comparison w/no filmy feeling after. Loads of lather=NO. Feel squeaky clean after=YES!!!! Suggestion: use disposable wash cloths.
my skin is absolutely GORGEOUS after using this cleansing oil but i also finished it of with the zero pore toner pads and let me tell you, my skin is tight, smooth, and blackhead free!

This product works great. Like any product you have to use it more than once to see results but you will see results if you use it daily. You rub the oil into your pores for at least a minute then add a little water to activate it and continue to rub it all over ,then rinse it all off and finsih with their face wash. You may end up getting more acne for a bit because you face it purging its impurties which is typical with any cleansing products. Soybean is considered risk free, Unless your allergic to soy.

avis.titre: First attempt at a cleansing oil
avis.texte: This is a nice cleanser. Light, pleasanf smell. Very different than a traditional cleanser but this makes my skin feel decongested and cleared a white head over night. It doesnt lather much (or i'm not using enough) but i dont mind this because it doesnt feel stripping.
It removes all of my makeup. It's kind of thick and has a very light scent. Not my favorite but I'll finish it

Nothing special as far as oil cleaners go, imo, doesn't help massage out blackheads or sebaceous filaments. But it washes off very well, no weird film on the skin after. Suitable for sensitive skin, no burning.

Have totally fallen in love with this cleanser. Use it to take off my makeup and then double cleanse with a water based one after. I have noticed a pretty visible reduction in blackheads and sebum. I am extremely acne prone and this hasnt broken me out at all. 10/10!

avis.titre: Did nothing for blackheads and soybean oil is bad
avis.texte: Soybean oil does not belong on your face, it is highly comedogenic, and this wash does not lather well or rinse off completely. Needless to even say, next day after using I have a pimple in an area of my face where I typically never break out, and the blackheads I bought this to target haven't remotely budged or risen to the surface. This is so overpriced for what it is: garbage.
I have used many cleansing oils/balms and this one is hands down the best. Easily takes off sunscreen and makeup. Gentle and effective! I will purchase forever.

avis.titre: Sebum and blackheads don't stand a chance
avis.texte: Ive tried a few cleansing oils, But none of them compared to this one. I have always had stubborn closed comedones on my chin and this stuff pulls them right out. I need to get another bottle for back asap.
